'''Reflections''' is the 23rd Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher in January 2000. It is 114 foil cards (57 per side): 87 very rare foils, 25 super rare foils, and 2 ultra rare foils ([[Darth Vader]] and [[Luke Skywalker]]). Two oversized objective box toppers (non-playable) shipped with displays: [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can]] and [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe]]. CardGuide numbering: 23rd product.

Packs are 18 cards, MSRP $4.95, 30 packs per box. Each pack has '''one foil''' from the list below plus random reprints from earlier expansions. Those reprints are not listed here. A foil of a title that is not on this list is not a Decipher Reflections pack foil (it may be a later [[Promotional Foils|promotional foil]], a Japanese foil, or a counterfeit).<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref>

== Box toppers ==
Each display included one of two '''oversized''' (about 5&Prime; &times; 7&Prime;) objective cards. They are promotional / non-playable and are '''not''' part of the 114 pack foils:<ref name="encyc" />

* [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can]]
* [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe]]

[[File:Reflections-box-toppers.png|640px|Reflections oversized box toppers]]

''Oversized box toppers. Standard-size cards in the same photo are for scale only.''

== Possible foils ==
114 titles: 87 very rare foils, 25 super rare foils, and 2 ultra rare foils ([[Darth Vader]] Dark and [[Luke Skywalker]] Light). Ultra rares appeared once on one of the two foil sheets per side.<ref name="encyc" />

== Print sheets ==
Foils are 10&times;10 (100 cards). Each side had two foil sheets. Ultra rare foil once on one of the two sheets; super rare foil 2&times; across both; very rare foil 4&times; across both.<ref name="encyc" />
